name: yukta
description: Live view of Yukta runs and approvals in Claude Code: a /yukta pane, status line, toasts, an approval band and the Yukta MCP server

server_url.title: Yukta server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of the Yukta server, without a trailing slash

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Sent as X-API-Key. Leave empty for a server without authentication

headers_command.title: Headers command
headers_command.description: Optional shell command that prints a JSON object of request headers (for the mod's REST calls); wins over the API key

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often the mod asks the server for running executions and approvals

show_status.title: Status line entry
show_status.description: Show the server and run counts in the status line
